title: Hydrodynamic Limit of the Boltzmann Equation toward Generic Riemann Solutions with Shocks
summary: We establish the hydrodynamic limit of the one-dimensional Boltzmann equation with hard-sphere collisions toward Riemann solutions of the compressible Euler system. The Riemann solutions covered by our result include generic superpositions of elementary waves: either two shock waves and a contact discontinuity, or a rarefaction wave, a contact discontinuity, and a shock wave.
